Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the intro via Marissa last week — Solora's been looking forward to seeing Redwood run against two of our core flows (support ticket summarization + multi-account search). We want to make sure this first demo lands at the right level: our VP of Eng (Michael) and Head of Security will join if possible.

A couple asks so we can make this productive:
- Can you confirm a Redwood executive (VP/Head of Product or Sales Engineering) will be on the call for the first 30 mins to set scope?
- Any pre-read / agenda you recommend we share with our VP & security lead?
- Do you have a short security matrix (SOC2 controls, data residency options) we can review ahead of time?

Proposed windows (PST):
- Thu 9/10 09:00–10:00
- Thu 9/10 11:00–12:00
- Fri 9/11 13:00–14:00

Attaching a short note on our use cases. If one of the Thu slots works we can lock it today.

Best,
Samantha Chen
Ops Lead, Solora Labs

Quick answers:
- I can have Marissa (Product) open the call and I'll join for the first half to cover roadmap & guarantees. Ben Carter (Solutions) will be on hand as a technical backup.
- Attached is a tight 1-pager agenda + suggested pre-reads.
- I've included our security matrix (high-level) and we can follow up with the SOC2 artifact if Michael's team wants deeper evidence (we typically provide an auditor's attestation via our compliance portal).

We can do Thu 9/10 11:00–12:00 PT — that's my preferred slot and gives your VP a slightly later window in the morning. If you prefer the earlier 09:00 slot, Marissa can lead and I can join at 09:15.

Proposed calendar invite: Thu 9/10 11:00–12:00 PT — will you confirm attendees and I'll send the invite and pre-reads?
